bugs_found: fx_convert looks up rates with reversed key (to_currency, from_currency) but multiplies as if it found from_currency -> to_currency, producing wrong conversions or false missing-rate errors.
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount; no validation or clamp prevents charging more than the transaction.
transfer mutates account_from before account_to; if account_to.balance update fails or has side effects, balances become inconsistent while a receipt is not returned.
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal/finite, so floats/strings/NaN can raise unexpected exceptions or break money precision guarantees.
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial behavior without validation.
